title: Hoshino Ichika — The Starry Sky I Saw〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, why don't we call it a day?
Your homework will be to work on what we each talked about today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, I almost forgot! How are your lyrics coming along?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is this about your next original song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Ichi even said so during our last show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well, it's just...
I was thinking about how I could turn how I feel right now into lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did get started on them but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm still having trouble expressing how I feel without holding myself back, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's this strange balancing act between trying to write what's on my mind and how embarrassed I feel about that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, is there anything anyone can do about that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And the lyrics you wrote for our last song were really good, so I'm sure you'll do just fine with our next one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why you just need to let you be you more, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll keep trying to find the right words for expressing how I truly feel.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the same time, it'd be interesting to see what you come up with if you took the opposite approach, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I can tell you a little about that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
They went something like...
“English is so melancholy... Please, clock...”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-That was just something I wrote after thinking about what cool lyrics sound like for far too long...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! You know you don't have to take everything that seriously, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, I don't think you need to try so hard to be cool.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because you've always been cool just the way you are. Ever since we were little♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
She's right.
One thing that I'll never forget is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: During elementary school, these boys were about to do something bad to me, but you jumped in and saved me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I remember that too!
They didn't know what to do after that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so heroic of you, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that kitten that one time too! You saw that it climbed up a tree and couldn't get down!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right. Ichika, you emptied out your entire backpack and climbed the tree to save it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And everything was doing so great up to the point where you put the kitten in your backpack but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You looked down, froze up and couldn't climb back down after that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right. And you saved me by finding a grown-up who could help me down, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Back then, Ichika, you really just let your actions speak for themselves.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know, right? There were a few times when you tried to get people to make up without really knowing what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, when it rained this one time, you used your textbook as an umbrella for me so that I wouldn't get wet!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we have so many more amazing stories to go through, Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. But I understand now. Ichika's cool and wonderful just the way she is.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, that's why I think you should just write what you feel. You're already the most amazing person ever as it is, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I tried writing more lyrics after that, but I'm still having trouble really expressing myself...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How interesting these lyrics sound isn't what's important. How you feel should take priority, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I think you should just write what you feel. You're already the most amazing person ever as it is, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (KAITO was right to say that and I'm glad he did. Even Saki said so herself...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But as happy as I am about what they said, putting pen to paper is a different story. I still feel like I'm missing something...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hmm... I have to think that it has to do with me not having the tools or vocabulary to properly express myself...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Back then, Ichika, you really just let your actions speak for themselves.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Letting my actions speak for themselves...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Before junior high, I definitely was like that.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We were all put into different classes and began to drift apart. Before I knew it, I wasn't able to talk to them like I used to...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I learned to read situations better as a result, but all I could do was watch as my friends moved further and further away. Especially Honami and Shiho...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't do what I was able to before, and probably wouldn't be able to even if I tried...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Since I used to just let my actions speak for themselves back then, I may've even had a much easier time writing lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something the matter? Anything bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika, there's something I'd like to show you. Would you mind coming with me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? It's... A ball of light...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Did a star fall and...
No, that can't be possible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is a fragment of a feeling.
I noticed it while playing my guitar just now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. It's not quite ready to become its own SEKAI yet, but it's here nonetheless...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, I am fairly certain that it was drawn to this SEKAI because of your feelings and that of your friends', Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you like to try touching it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You may even find the answers you've been looking for by doing so.
